name: New Body, New Life
source:
New Body, New Life will follow the adventures of a nameless man inside the body of Nicole Miller, a hooker without aspirations beside having sex with many guys. Now you are in control of Nicole's life and will have to face the bad decisions that Nicole has made in her life.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/mmirror]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《New Body, New Life》讲述一名无名男子进入妮可·米勒身体后的冒险。妮可是一名性工作者，除了与许多男人发生关系之外，别无追求。如今，你将掌控妮可的人生，面对她过去种种错误决定带来的后果。

[编译自[url=https://www.patreon.com/mmirror]Patreon[/url]]
